tbesh_html:
1) thigh, side, loin, base
1a) thigh
1a1) outside of thigh (where sword was worn)
1a2) loins (as the seat of procreative power)
1b) side (flank) (of object)
1c) base

strongs_1890.strongs_def: the thigh (from its fleshy softness); by euphemistically the generative parts; figuratively, a shank, flank, side
strongs_1890.derivation: from an unused root meaning to be soft;
